esukh.description: esukh (иСӨХ) is Hubilai Tech's (HTI) app for apartment owners' associations (СӨХ) and the pilot source of the HTI data platform: a MySQL 8 database of 241 tables, restored nightly. branchId columns identify the СӨХ (branch table, 'СӨХ-ны сан'; DDL comment 'СӨХ-ын id'), and esukh.property is the residential estate; person columns are per-column UUID tokens, so a person's userId, workerId, currentUserId etc. tokens do not join to each other (claude.md G18).
